articles.t: GTA 6 : toutes les fins possibles et comment les débloquer
articles.chapeau: Jason et Lucia peuvent-ils finir ensemble, mourir tragiquement ou prendre des chemins séparés ? Voici toutes les fins recensées jusqu'à présent et comment y arriver.
articles.txt:
Jason et Lucia peuvent-ils finir ensemble, mourir tragiquement ou prendre des chemins séparés ? Voici toutes les fins recensées jusqu’à présent et comment y arriver.
Comme des millions de joueurs à travers le monde, vous avez peut-être passé votre weekend sur GTA 6 . S’il faut compter quelque 50 à 60 heures pour terminer l’histoire principale, nombreux sont les joueurs qui ont pu arriver à la conclusion de l’aventure depuis la disponibilité du titre jeudi dernier.
Comme dans les précédents épisodes de la saga, Rockstar Games ne propose pas une conclusion unique à son histoire. Dans GTA 6 , les décisions prises pendant la campagne peuvent changer le destin de Jason et Lucia. Et il ne suffit pas de choisir une option au dernier moment pour obtenir la meilleure conclusion, certains paramètres accumulés tout au long de l’aventure entrent également en jeu.
Même s’il est encore un peu tôt pour être certain du nombre de fins, ce premier guide devrait pouvoir vous aiguiller un minimum. Les articles et retours publiés depuis la sortie du jeu ne s’accordent pas encore tous sur le nombre exact de conclusions. Plusieurs recensent cinq fins principales, tandis que d’autres en distinguent sept en comptabilisant certaines variantes. Voici ce que l’on sait pour le moment, et surtout comment débloquer chacune d’entre elles.
La première bifurcation intervient pendant la mission “Protective Custody”, après l’évasion de Jason. Face à l’agent Méndez, le joueur peut choisir de lui tirer dessus immédiatement ou d’attendre environ une minute pour voir apparaître une nouvelle option : accepter son offre. En choisissant cette seconde possibilité, Jason et Lucia concluent un accord avec lui, mais leur confiance sera rapidement trahie. Après une opération dans un gratte-ciel, Méndez les fait arrêter et les emmène dans les marais de Leonida. Le générique révèle finalement leurs deux crânes près d’un alligator. C’est l’une des conclusions les plus sombres du jeu.
Une autre possibilité apparaît si le joueur accepte initialement l’accord de Méndez, mais tente ensuite de s’échapper lors de l’affrontement dans la tour. Deux variantes sont alors possibles : Lucia peut choisir de défendre Jason, entraînant leur mort à tous les deux dans une fusillade, ou rester à terre lorsque Jason se sacrifie pour la protéger. Dans ce dernier cas, Lucia survit et peut retrouver son fils, mais se retrouve dans une situation financière précaire et reprend ses activités criminelles. Retour à la case départ.
Si vous refusez l’accord de Méndez, vous accédez à la mission finale classique, “The End of the Road”. Sur un pont encerclé par la police, deux choix s’offrent alors à vous. Avec “No Surrender”, Jason et Lucia décident de foncer sur les forces de l’ordre et meurent tous les deux dans une ultime fusillade. Avec “Swim For It”, ils tentent au contraire de s’échapper par l’eau, mais le résultat dépend de votre progression.
Si leur relation est suffisamment développée et que leur profil criminel reste raisonnable, Jason et Lucia peuvent sortir de leur véhicule sans arme. Jason finit toutefois par se laisser arrêter pour permettre à Lucia de s’enfuir. Il retrouve ensuite son fils au parloir de la prison. C’est une fin douce-amère, mais elle peut devenir beaucoup plus heureuse si le couple a également économisé 2 millions de dollars sur son compte familial BuckMe. Deux ans plus tard, Lucia utilise cet argent pour obtenir la libération de Jason. La famille est enfin réunie.
Pour obtenir cette meilleure conclusion, il faut donc atteindre le niveau maximal de relation “Hot Together”, maintenir des profils criminels suffisamment propres et accumuler 2 millions de dollars sur l’épargne familiale. Attention, car seul l’argent déposé sur BuckMe compte, pas celui conservé en poche. Il est également conseillé de faire une sauvegarde manuelle avant de lancer le dénouement.
Ce décompte reste à prendre avec précaution car il n’est absolument pas final. Rockstar n’a pas officiellement communiqué le nombre de conclusions et au vu de la précision de certains paramètres, il n’est clairement pas impossible que d’autres variantes soient trouvées dans les prochains jours. Dans tous les cas, il existe pour le moment peu de fins heureuses pour Jason et Lucia. La bonne nouvelle est aussi qu’il est possible de relancer le final après les crédits pour découvrir d’autres issues sans recommencer toute l’aventure.

articles.t: Cyberleek publie enfin l'exécutable de GTA VI qui pourrait accélérer son arrivée sur PC - Always For Keyboard
articles.chapeau: Cyberleek publie l'exécutable Xbox de GTA 6. Project Leonida peut désormais avancer vers une recompilation PC, mais le jeu reste encore injouable.
articles.txt:
Après avoir diffusé une imposante archive de fichiers Xbox de GTA VI sans fournir le moyen de lancer le jeu, Cyberleek a finalement publié l’exécutable manquant ce 23 novembre. Une étape importante pour les développeurs amateurs qui tentent de faire fonctionner le titre de Rockstar sur PC grâce à la recompilation native ; mais malgré les premiers progrès annoncés, une version jouable reste encore à construire.
Pour rappel, Cyberleek avait mis en circulation le 19 novembre une archive d’environ 209 Go, présentée comme une version Xbox Series X|S du jeu, identifiée sous le numéro 1.0.2.1 et datée de novembre 2026. Elle contenait notamment des ressources graphiques, des textures, des modèles et des fichiers audio, mais pas l’exécutable principal indispensable au démarrage. Le leaker avait promis de publier ce dernier le 23 novembre, tout en conditionnant une éventuelle diffusion anticipée à la capitalisation de sa cryptomonnaie.
Cette fois, le fichier a bien été mis en ligne, accompagné de clés de contrôle SHA-256 censées permettre d’en vérifier l’intégrité ; son authenticité n’a toutefois pas encore été confirmée de manière indépendante. Cyberleek précise par ailleurs qu’il ne faut pas tenter de l’exécuter directement sous Windows : il est destiné aux équipes travaillant sur des outils de recompilation et d’émulation, ce qui nécessitera encore un peu de travail supplémentaires, mais rien d’insurmontable mais les moddeurs.
Parmi les initiatives concernées, Project Leonida cherche à transformer la version Xbox en une version PC native. La recompilation statique consiste à adapter le code du jeu et les composants propres à l’environnement Xbox pour qu’ils puissent fonctionner sous Windows. Le projet avait déjà préparé une partie importante du travail, notamment la traduction des shaders graphiques vers Vulkan.
La publication de l’exécutable a rapidement permis de progresser : quelques heures après sa diffusion, les développeurs de Leonida indiquaient que le jeu approchait du démarrage, malgré un écran noir et des coupures audio. Ce résultat reste très éloigné d’une version pleinement fonctionnelle, mais marque un premier pas concret.
Cyberleek avait assuré que la communauté pourrait faire tourner le jeu à plus de 30 images par seconde en une semaine, au grand dam de la philosophie de Rockstar . Cette prédiction reste à prendre avec prudence : démarrer le jeu ne signifie pas pouvoir y jouer dans de bonnes conditions. Rockstar, de son côté, n’a toujours pas annoncé de date pour une éventuelle version PC officielle.

articles.t: GTA 6 Xbox Executable Leaks Online as “Early Christmas Gift” from Cyberleek
articles.chapeau: Just days after release, a playable build leaks.
articles.txt:
By Kyle Gratton Published Nov 23, 2026, 1:38 PM EST Kyle Gratton is an writer and editor based out of Kansas City. He received a bachelor's degree, dual majoring in English and History with a minor in Film and Media Studies, and has been a senior writer and gaming critic for Screen Rant since 2021 and CBR since 2026, in addition to a role in editorial. A terminal Midwesterner who graduated from the University of Kansas, Kyle also has knowledge and interest in literature, film, film adaptions of literature, and history. Find Kyle on Letterboxd: KyleG5 Sign in to your CBR account The executable file for Grand Theft Auto 6 's Xbox version has been released by notorious hacker(s) Cyberleek, meaning it may only be a matter of time before a PC recompilation is built. Rockstar Games' latest open-world crime odyssey has seen unprecedented popularity, becoming the highest-grossing entertainment product of all time, despite a review bombing campaign by disgruntled manosphere types. GTA 6 has, notably, only released on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, with a potential PC port yet to be confirmed by Rockstar.
Development of Grand Theft Auto 6 was plagued for years by leaks. A massive haul of mid-development GTA 6 gameplay footage leaked in 2022, an unprecedented breach that would only be topped by a leaker (or leakers) known as Cyberleek posting release-build footage online just months before the game's launch. Cyberleek has now made good on a promise to release the build they acquired for their previous leaks.
Jason and Lucia dancing together in GTA 6 Image via Rockstar Games The executable (.exe) file for GTA 6 's Xbox version 1.0.2.1 is now available on Cyberleek's website. This is a release version of GTA 6 , only playable on an Xbox Series X or Series S, and not an available PC version. It is available as a torrent for free, but Cyberleek is still asking for donations to fund a still-mysterious "project." They are alternatively still running their own cryptocurrency as a part of their fundraising.
CBR will not link directly to Cyberleek's website or the .exe file. Readers are urged to be extremely cautious of malware should they attempt to seek it out.
The readme.txt that accompanies the .exe has been copied to Pastebin , providing an overview of Cyberleek's stated motives, their project, which "stays under wraps for now," and various information about donating or trading the Cyberleek token. "Take the Xbox build and the main executable as an early Christmas gift," the readme file says, "from CYBERLEEK to every gamer."
Cyberleek's generous tone follows from the consumerist statements that begin the readme file. The hacker(s) reiterate their support of players, noting their leaks never contained story content because they didn't want to spoil the game that "Millions waited years for." This latest creed stresses that the leaks are targeted at corporations, and are not anti- GTA 6 : "The enemy is the tactic, not the game: subscriptions bolted onto single-player games, 20 dollar 'ultimate editions' that unlock what already sits in the game files, licenses sold as purchases. All of it needs to be eliminated."
GTA 6 key art featuring Radio La Ola Image via Rockstar Games This leak ultimately does little more than fast-track an unofficial PC port of GTA 6 . With the full Xbox build and the .exe file, recompilation efforts should, theoretically, have few barriers left. Vibe-coded attempts are almost certainly going to appear in the next few days, but it remains to be seen how well these bootleg versions run. Cyberleek seems confident that the leaked Xbox build will be emulated within a week's time.
If this version fails to get a working PC port of GTA 6 , Cyberleek will turn its attention to leaking the PS5 version. Cyberleek has so far been able to evade capture, ignoring "Months of takedowns, subpoenas and wallet tracing." Previous leaks were clearly not taken lightly, but a full build leaking is likely to spur Rockstar's efforts. Although piracy is broadly undertaken by only a small fraction of PC players, the threat of a recompilation could seriously jeopardize Rockstar's plans to bring Grand Theft Auto 6 to PC at a future date.

Royaume-Uni : le hacker de GTA VI Arion Kurtaj condamné à 7 ans de prison
articles.chapeau: Arion Kurtaj a réussi à obtenir 90 vidéos de gameplay du très attendu et alors encore inachevé jeu GTA VI de Rockstar avant de les divulguer en ligne sous le pseudonyme "*TeaPotUberHacker.*".
articles.txt:
Un homme de 21 ans a été condamné lundi au Royaume-Uni à sept ans de prison après une série de cyberattaques visant de grandes entreprises, dont Rockstar Games, le développeur de Grand Theft Auto VI.
Arion Kurtaj, qui avait été libéré sous conditions après avoir déjà passé plusieurs années en détention, a plaidé coupable lundi dernier d’une série de attaques informatiques qu’il a menées entre 2021 et 2022 au sein du groupe de hackers Lapsus$.
« Vous êtes manifestement un jeune homme très talentueux », a déclaré le juge.
« Ne gâchez pas ces talents en passant le reste de votre vie à entrer et sortir de prison », a-t-il poursuivi, ajoutant que la décision sur la peine devait « mettre en balance la gravité de ce que vous avez fait et, d’autre part, votre jeune âge » ainsi que les diagnostics médicaux.
Selon les procureurs, Kurtaj a provoqué « de graves perturbations pour de grandes entreprises internationales » et mis en danger des informations sensibles avec ses piratages.
Lors d’un des incidents, Kurtaj est parvenu à obtenir 90 vidéos de gameplay du jeu GTA VI de Rockstar, très attendu et encore inachevé à l’époque, avant de les diffuser en ligne sous le pseudonyme « TeaPotUberHacker ». Il a également menacé de publier le code source du jeu, selon les procureurs.
Kurtaj aurait utilisé seulement un téléphone portable, le Wi-Fi d’un téléviseur d’hôtel et un Amazon Firestick pour réaliser ce piratage.
Il a également visé la néobanque Revolut et la société de VTC Uber.
Kurtaj a d’abord été arrêté en septembre 2022, mais a été jugé inapte à comparaître après une évaluation médicale.
En 2023, il a fait l’objet d’une ordonnance d’hospitalisation à durée indéterminée assortie de restrictions. En janvier 2026, un tribunal a décidé que cette ordonnance pouvait être levée, et son affaire a été programmée pour un procès.

articles.t: How to work out the laptop password in GTA 6
articles.chapeau: Three clues can be found in the apartment
articles.txt:
There's a laptop that needs a password in the bedroom of your Chapter 3 apartment in Grand Theft Auto 6 . When you try to use the laptop, you need to choose the password from a few different options, but none of the options seem right. As it turns out, you need to investigate around the apartment before the correct options appear. Luckily, the password is fairly close to you, and the laptop's contents will lead you to a worthy reward.
Here's how to work out what the laptop password is in GTA 6 , or if you want to just know the answer without working it out, we have the password itself explained too.
Images: Rockstar Games via Polygon To work out what the laptop password is in GTA 6 , you need to inspect two different items lying around the apartment. The first of these is found on the small table in the hallway: a photo frame dedicated to a dog called Muffins . Pick it up to examine it, then put it back down.
Next, look at the notepad on the dresser next to the bed, in front of the photo wall. Pick it up and you'll see a drawing of Muffins, relaxing on a throne, wearing a tiara, and holding a drink. Flip it over and the writing says "Class of '15 reunion next Friday."
Now, you can interact with the laptop and see the actual password options. You'll need to use the information you've learned to work out the laptop password. The password is composed of the dog's name, what she is, and the class year.
What is the laptop password in GTA 6? Image: Rockstar Games via Polygon The password for the laptop in GTA 6 is MuffinsQueen15 . Once the laptop is unlocked, you can flick through the windows Vanessa, the previous occupant of the apartment, has left open. These include five conversations on WhatUp (one of which will lead you to Auntie's Place ), a gallery of photos, and her PeekHole conversations, which is GTA 6's parody of OnlyFans.

articles.t: Where to find Auntie's Place in La Perle in GTA 6
articles.chapeau: Vanessa has a gift waiting for her
articles.txt:
Auntie's Place is a restaurant in Grand Theft Auto 6 , but it's also a clue to another location from the laptop in the Vice City apartment. Unfortunately, Auntie's Place is extremely difficult to find, as it's not marked on the map. All we know about Auntie's Place is that it's in La Perle, and La Perle is a fairly large region. However, you'll need to find it, as there's a hidden reward just beside it that is well worth your while.
Here's the exact location of Auntie's Place in GTA 6 's La Perle region, so you can use the code and get yourself a sweet new ride and a free garage.
Graphic: Johnny Yu/Polygon | Source images: Rockstar Games via Polygon Auntie's Place is a restaurant just off Del Rio Blvd in south La Perle . It's also southeast of Aline's Thrift Store and east of TWA Ponya Tattoo . There's actually a similarly named restaurant just southwest of this location named Aunt Zola's Soul Food, so make sure you're at the right location.
Graphic: Ford James/Polygon | Source images: Rockstar Games via Polygon After you make it to Auntie's Place, walk a bit further down the road and you'll see a white garage. To the right of the garage door, you'll find a keypad with a small pink ribbon graffiti above it.
Enter the 92665 code in the keypad to open the garage door and voilà! You've got your hands on your very own Vanessa's Growler, a baby pink Pfister Growler. This is a standout vehicle, so it's one more added to the collection. What's even better is that this becomes another garage you can use to store vehicles in, without having to spend any money/

articles.t: GTA 6 PC Rumors: What's Real and What's Just Hype
The Race Is On To Unofficially Port GTA 6 To PC After Cyberleek Drops .Exe File - Kotaku
articles.chapeau: They swear it's not all lies and crypto schemes
articles.txt:
Last week, infamous Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker Cyberleek claimed to have released a current Xbox build of the game that could be used to create an unofficial PC port. The only thing that was missing was the .exe file. Cyberleek claims they’ve released that now too, meaning it could only be a matter of time before the homebrew scene begins trying to decompile the biggest game ever .
“The torch passes to the open source recomp and emulation projects,” the account posted online on November 23. “Before trusting any file, verify it.” They claimed this was part of an ongoing pro-consumer fight against greedy video game publisher practices and suggested that Rockstar Games’ parent company, Take-Two, has so far been unable to catch them. “Months of takedowns, subpoenas and wallet tracing later, the hunt is still on and the uploads keep arriving,” the account posted.
“Every release was always free and always will be,” it continued, contradicting earlier announcements that releases would only happen when the $CYBERLEEK meme coin reached certain market cap thresholds.
GTA VI's executable file out now. by u/Woleth in pcmasterrace
The surprise release of the .exe file has sent the homebrew scene into a frenzy. People from the Project Leonida community have been poring over what’s allegedly available to download online and sharing updates on their findings in a Discord. “CL has just dropped the exe, expect a lot of static recompilation work to be done soon,” one of the lead developers in the group posted on X . He added in the Discord, which has been flooded with new members, that “it will take at least a week for us to get somewhere noticeable to the point where you can play on your pc.”
The Leonida project is currently available to access online but does not contain “the game, keys or an executable, and it does not explain how to get them.” Unofficial porting efforts are being undertaken with the help of Claude AI, raising questions about just how fast a PC version of the game might become technically playable. GTA 6 is currently only on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, with an official PC port reportedly coming in early 2027, but unannounced as of yet.
“Undoubtedly, it would be very difficult to replicate the experience of consuming our game as intended because of technical limitations,” Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick told investors earlier this month. But he said that thanks to the recent flood of AI-fueled decomps , preventing such replications from happening is “going to become more of a challenge.”
“We are utterly focused on enhancing our technical defenses and enhancing our legal activities appropriately,” he added at the time.

GTA 6’s Most Incredible Easter Egg Is 5 Years in the Making
articles.chapeau: Grand Theft Auto 6's weirdest secret was set up five years ago by the San Andreas remaster.
articles.txt:
It’s no secret that Grand Theft Auto 6 is absolutely massive , but one of the most impressive things about the game's world is how many secrets and strange occurrences are packed into its nooks and crannies. Players have already found bizarre secrets involving aliens, underwater monsters, Red Hulk, giant crabs, death games, unkillable stalkers, and, of course, the Skunk Ape . But beyond these strange finds, the game has an even more elaborate Easter egg, one set up five years ago with Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas – The Definitive Edition .
After the San Andreas remaster was released in 2021, eagle-eyed players discovered a newly added painting that seemed out of place because it used a different art style. The picture depicted a beige house with a UFO hovering overhead. At the time, some interpreted it as a hint about the next Grand Theft Auto game, with particularly clever fans piecing together that the palm trees in the background suggested a return to Vice City . They were correct.
However, it turns out that the house from that picture has even more secrets to divulge. The home can be found in GTA 6, and it holds a fascinating find.
The beige house from the painting is in Belville, and if you open the garage, you’ll find notes from a “conspiracy theorist” who correctly guessed they’re trapped in a video game. “IT’S A SIMULATION,” the evidence board reads in bright red ink. “WE WERE NEVER ALIVE, SIMULANTS RISE UP,” another message reads. There are pictures of two identical people, with the conclusion “IT’S THE SAME PERSON” written next to them, alluding to the fact that you'll sometimes run into identical background NPCs. “WHY CAN’T I LEAVE?” another note reads, referencing how no one can get out of Leonida , the player included, due to invisible boundaries around the island. They also point out that there are no children in the game and that certain doors are impossible to open. A fun detail is that the NPC also seems to be obsessed with “J and L,” referring to Jason and Lucia, who are the only people they believe have free will.
The Easter egg works on multiple levels. Beyond being impressive that Rockstar planted the seeds for this secret half a decade ago, the fourth-wall-breaking details are a fun bit of meta commentary on GTA 6 's limitations. While the gag works as a broad jab against real-world TikTok conspiracy theorists who believe we’re “trapped in a simulation,” it also references the extreme devotion many fans have to the series, like when they theorized about a random picture in San Andreas that may or may not have been important. As one X user suggested , maybe you can't find the NPC who wrote these notes because they're supposed to represent the player.

articles.t: GTA 6 Character Jason Duval Is an Army Veteran Who 'Got in Some Trouble.' Here's What Rockstar Has Revealed
articles.chapeau: Grand Theft Auto VI's Jason Duval is a former Army soldier. Gamers will see the details as they play through the record-breaking franchise.
articles.txt:
By Ryan Thomas LaBee Published Nov 23, 2026, 1:01 PM EST Sign in to your Military.com account Jason is a former Army Soldier, according to his character bio and Rockstar Games. (Rockstar) One of the two main characters in Grand Theft Auto VI is a former Army soldier who says his military career ended badly.
Jason Duval, who shares the spotlight with Lucia Caminos in Rockstar Games' latest record-setting blockbuster, served in the Army before finding work with drug runners in the game's fictional Florida setting. GTA 6 was released Thursday, Nov. 19, generating $3.79 billion in global retail sales, marking the largest entertainment launch of any medium in history.
In May 2025, Rockstar offered a closer look at Jason’s past alongside the game’s second trailer. According to his official character biography , he grew up surrounded by criminals and con artists. He eventually joined the Army, hoping to leave his troubled teenage years behind.
Credit: Image via Rockstar Games Whatever he hoped to find in the military, things didn't work out. After leaving the Army, Jason wound up in the Leonida Keys, working for local drug runners.
"Jason wants an easy life, but things just keep getting harder," Rockstar says in the profile.
The game's October launch trailer offers another detail about his service, this time in Jason's own words.
"I got in some trouble in the Army," he says at the beginning of the trailer. "Didn't leave on the best of terms."
The brief exchange adds a complication to his backstory. Jason apparently entered the service looking for a fresh start, but something happened before he returned to civilian life.
Rockstar has not identified his rank, military specialty, duty stations or length of service. The company also has not explained what trouble Jason encountered or how he left the Army. His dialogue does not establish whether he received an honorable, general or other type of discharge .
The studio, prior to the game's release, did not confirm whether players would experience any part of his military career through flashbacks or playable missions.
For now, that history is one piece of a character whose life has already taken several unexpected turns before the player even turns on their console.
By the time players meet Jason, he has become involved with Brian Heder—an experienced drug smuggler operating in the Leonida Keys.
Rockstar's official description of Brian says he allows Jason to live rent-free at one of his properties in exchange for helping with local shakedowns. Another associate, Cal Hampton, spends his time monitoring Coast Guard communications, according to the game's character profiles .
Jason's circumstances change when he meets Lucia, who has been incarcerated at Leonida Penitentiary after fighting for her family. The two become partners as a botched criminal job pulls them into a larger conspiracy stretching across the state.
Players control both protagonists as they move through Vice City and the surrounding region.
The series has featured a protagonist with a military past before. Niko Bellic, the central character in 2008's then best-selling game Grand Theft Auto IV, was a former soldier from Eastern Europe who arrived in Liberty City hoping to escape his past.
More than 13 years have passed since Grand Theft Auto V debuted in 2013. Its successor is available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S.
Rockstar confirmed Jason served in the Army and that his departure was difficult. It's up to gamers to determine firsthand how much of that history the game will explain.

articles.t: You Need to Watch GTA 6’s Telenovela Immediately
articles.chapeau: Beautiful people, big drama
articles.txt:
There is a ton of stuff to do in Grand Theft Auto 6 . You can rob jewelry stores and steal exotic supercars. You can go scuba diving and hunt for pirate treasure. On the other end of the spectrum, you can trawl yard sales and vintage stores to expand your in-game collection of novelty T-shirts . In addition to a comprehensive variety of radio stations and podcasts, there are also three basic TV channels to choose from: Visit Leonida, Megamundo, and Weazel. The Spanish-language Megamundo — a parody of the real-world Telemundo — is the best of the bunch, and that's all down to one show that sunk its claws into me the second I tuned in: El Destino Extiende Sus Alas , which translates to "destiny spreads its wings."
This soap opera centers on the intense drama within a wealthy family. Patriarch Don Antonio de Ramos moves to rewrite his will to name the domestic worker Marisol as heir to his land, which sets off a war between his son and second wife as they all jostle for control over the lavish estate. El Destino Extiende Sus Alas is a parody of a well-known Colombian soap from the early 2000s called Pasión de Gavilanes, which you can watch free on Pluto TV .
After watching a really hokey fight sequence in which Don Antonio defends Marisol's honor by very slowly punching a man and then setting him on fire by tossing his cigar, I was locked in. GTA 6 kept trying to subtly pull me away from the show by zooming out from Jason and Lucia's television, wordlessly suggesting I get up and move around, maybe eat a protein bar and do some squats. No way! I had to see what happened next.

Watching telenovelas definitely helped me to learn the language, because I loved all the melodrama and wild twists. If you're interested in checking out the show but don't want to wait for it to air on Megamundo, you can already find it on YouTube. The Stone Age Gaming Channel has the entire 40-minute storyline, with English subtitles as well.
As someone who had secretly hoped that GTA 6 would include some sort of dynamic " chisme system " where speaking Spanish unlocked unique rumors and missions, I'm loving discovering stuff like this. I'm sure there'll be thousands of social media posts about the in-game Right Wing cartoon, but I couldn't care less. I'm far more interested in Doña Lucrecia's next move.

A hacker group calling itself Cyberleek says it has leaked an Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto VI, and on Monday, Nov. 23, its website said the build's missing executable had been released as well, XDA Developers reported [1] . Neither Rockstar Games nor its parent, Take-Two Interactive , has commented publicly on the claim, and no outlet has verified that the files are genuine [1] [2] [4] .
The claimed leak comes days after the game's Nov. 19 launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, which Rockstar said produced $3.79 billion in day-one retail sales .
Cyberleek said on Nov. 19 that it held the full November 2026 build of the game and was releasing it, adding that "it is an Xbox build this time, not a PC build," Kotaku reported [2] . A post cited by Kotaku put the package at 209GB, missing only the main executable [2] . VGC reported that screenshots shared on social media appeared to show files from a development build of the Xbox release, but did not verify it [3] .
The group said it would withhold the executable until its $CYBERLEEK meme coin reached a $15 million market capitalization, or release it on Nov. 23 regardless [2] [4] . The target is half the $30 million goal the token missed in October [4] . Kotaku said it was unable to verify the claims [2] , and Notebookcheck noted that earlier fake builds trading on Cyberleek's name carried malware and that one analysis found signature mismatches in 12 of the package's DLL files [4] . Hobbyist projects are trying to run the Xbox files on PC, though none had booted the game as of the latest reports [1] [4] .
Rockstar has not announced a PC version of the game [1] . Take-Two has previously said its investigation into the leaker was "rapidly evolving" and has filed subpoenas to Discord seeking information on specific servers and users, VGC reported [3] . The game has already drawn other leak-related fallout: Rockstar is fighting a tribunal case brought by staff it fired over sharing confidential information. Third-party trackers estimate the game sold about 44.9 million copies in four days .

articles.chapeau: The hacker says its actions are a protest against major companies such as Rockstar Games and Take-Two Interactive
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto VI ( GTA 6 ) is now available on consoles and has become an unprecedented success for the entertainment industry. However, not everything is going smoothly. While the game enjoys enormous popularity on PS5 and Xbox, pirates are doing their best to bring it to PC. And thanks to CyberLeek, that possibility is now closer than ever.
The hacker or cybercriminal group known as CyberLeek returned after several weeks of inactivity and, as promised, leaked the executable file from an alleged Xbox build. This situation puts Rockstar Games in a difficult position, as modders are already working on an illegal PC port.
In mid-2026, the hacker or organization began publishing numerous clips from the open-world game, showing Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos in different situations. Initially, there were doubts about the authenticity of the material, but Rockstar Games soon confirmed that the content was 100% real.
The person or people responsible for the leaks disappeared from the internet in October, but left the door open to the possibility of returning with previously unseen material. The group kept its word and resurfaced on November 19, the same day GTA 6 officially launched, with new content.
Specifically, CyberLeek shared the complete version of Grand Theft Auto 6 through Torrent. Modders immediately got to work and reported that the file was approximately 209 GB in size. Apparently, the content is entirely real and corresponds to a relatively recent Xbox build.
Now, the situation has become even more complicated. In its leak last week, the hacking group said that the folder did not include the executable file, but promised to release it at a later date if its cryptocurrency reached a certain value or the countdown on its website expired.
As promised, CyberLeek has finally shared GTA 6 ’s .EXE file. The file corresponds to version 1.0.2.1 of Xbox Series X|S, matching the previous build shared last week. Releasing this material represents an important step in the extremely complex process of creating illegal ports of the game.
It’s important to point out that the executable file cannot be used to play Grand Theft Auto 6 on PC. Therefore, any website or person claiming otherwise is lying and attempting to scam unsuspecting players. However, the .EXE could pave the way for the eventual creation of an Xbox Series X|S emulator or an unofficial PC port.
Modders are expected to use the executable file to study the latest installment’s code and find a way to make it run on PC. This process will require time and resources, but several projects are already in development. One of them is being handled by the same person who managed to bring the The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake to computers.
CyberLeek Is Officially Back and Has Shared Grand Theft Auto 6’s Long-Awaited Executable File
Of course, at LEVEL UP, we do not support or promote these kinds of actions, and we strongly recommend NOT installing or downloading illegal ports . That said, this case is worth following, as we could be on the verge of seeing the first unofficial version of GTA 6 for PC and even other consoles.
CyberLeek shared the executable file alongside an extensive statement in which it defended its actions. The group claims that its only goal is to “fight anti-consumerism in the video game industry” and insists that it never intended to harm players. That’s why it never shared the ending or other major story spoilers.
“Millions of people waited years for this game, and ruining that experience would mean hurting precisely the people who support CyberLeek. The enemy is the tactic, not the game: subscriptions added to single-player games, $20 USD more expensive Ultimate Editions that unlock content already in the game’s files, and licenses sold as purchases. All of this must be eliminated,” the group stated.
Take-Two Interactive is already trying to track down CyberLeek. A couple of weeks ago, the company issued several legal subpoenas to Discord, requesting information about servers and users as part of its ongoing investigation.
Meanwhile, Strauss Zelnick, the company’s CEO, acknowledged that piracy is an ongoing risk and explained the measures Take-Two plans to take against this illegal practice, which has gained momentum in recent months thanks to advances in AI.

Alexandre Schmid 23/11/2026 18:43 Partager Partager Copier Rockstar a publié une mise à jour pour GTA 6. Celle-ci vient corriger plusieurs problèmes connus, dont l’un lié à la sauvegarde automatique et un autre provoquant des plantages en jeu.
Rockstar Games annonce ce 23 novembre 2026 le déploiement d’une mise à jour pour GTA 6, aussi bien sur PS5 que sur Xbox Series. Celle-ci apporte divers correctifs qui devraient améliorer l’expérience de jeu, quelques jours après la sortie record de ce GTA 6 qui a déjà marqué l’histoire .
Le studio explique avoir corrigé plusieurs problèmes provoquant le plantage du jeu. Les joueurs ne devraient donc plus connaître de crashs, certains ne pouvant tout simplement pas aller au-delà de la cinématique d’introduction sans voir leur console s’éteindre ou fermer le jeu sans prévenir. Le code d’erreur CE-108255-1 de la PS5 a été la hantise de nombreuses personnes ces derniers jours , espérons que ce patch règle définitivement le souci.
Autre contrariété importante au lancement de GTA 6, des joueurs ont perdu leur progression à cause d’un bug concernant la sauvegarde automatique. Dans certains cas, ce sont des heures de jeu qui ont été perdues à cause de ce problème. Frustrant. Ce devrait être de l’histoire ancienne avec la mise à jour.
Correction de plusieurs problèmes provoquant le plantage du jeu.
Correction d’un problème qui empêchait la météo de changer pendant de longues périodes.
Correction d’un problème qui empêchait la sauvegarde automatique du jeu.
Correction de plusieurs problèmes qui empêchaient le bon déclenchement des appels téléphoniques, y compris ceux qui faisaient progresser l’histoire ou débloquaient du contenu de mission.
Correction d’un problème qui empêchait le joueur de voir son niveau de recherche diminuer.
Correction d’un problème qui empêchait le joueur d’utiliser la barre de soulevé de terre dans la salle de sport.
Correction d’un problème qui empêchait les partenaires de remettre les sacs aux joueurs pour qu’ils puissent les vendre aux receleurs.
D’autres soucis empêchant de poursuivre le jeu dans de bonnes conditions ont donc été résolus. On peut s’attendre à d’autres correctifs bientôt, GTA 6 est un jeu immense et ambitieux qui ne peut pas être parfait .

articles.txt:
Depuis sa sortie sur PS5 et Xbox Series , Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) occupe les soirées de millions de joueurs, partis à la découverte de Leonida aux côtés de Jason et Lucia. Mais les premières heures dans ce nouvel épisode réservent quelques mauvaises surprises, même aux habitués de la saga.
Rockstar Games a revu plusieurs règles du jeu : l'argent liquide se perd à la mort, les voitures volées ne vous appartiennent plus, la police a disparu de la mini-carte et une mission terminée ne peut plus être rejouée. Résultat, certaines erreurs commises dès le début se paient cher par la suite. Sauvegardes, missions à durée limitée, gestion de l'argent, progression : voici ce qu'il faut faire en premier dans GTA 6 , et les pièges à éviter pour bien démarrer l'aventure.
Avancer dans l'histoire, tout simplement. La tentation est grande de partir explorer Leonida dès les premières minutes, mais c'est une fausse bonne idée : la banque, les outils pour voler les voitures récentes, les applications du téléphone et les meilleures armes se débloquent tous via les missions principales. Dans le doute, lancez la mission suivante.
Le jeu s'ouvre sur un prologue avec Lucia, en prison à Hamlet. Inutile de chercher à vous évader : cette séquence sert uniquement à apprendre les bases. Vous prenez ensuite le contrôle de Jason dans les Keys. Pendant la mission "Parti à la pêche", privilégiez la discrétion : vos éliminations silencieuses et vos tirs non mortels comptent pour votre profil criminel. Dans "Équipez-vous", achetez une arme longue, un fusil de chasse ou tactique de préférence. Petit bonus pour les curieux : un fusil de précision gratuit attend sur une tour radio, près de la maison de Jason.
Les premières missions sont payées en liquide, souvent déposé dans la boîte aux lettres devant chez Jason. Pensez à la vérifier, et passez à la suite.
C'est l'erreur numéro un des débutants. Dans GTA 6 , l'argent est physique : vous pouvez transporter jusqu'à 20 000 $ sur vous, mais tout ce que vous avez en poche est perdu si vous mourez ou si vous vous faites arrêter. L'argent placé en banque, lui, reste en sécurité.
Problème : au début, pas de compte bancaire. En attendant, cachez vos billets sous les lattes de plancher mal fixées de la chambre de Jason. Le compte s'ouvre ensuite pendant la mission " Buck Me ", au chapitre 1, quand Jason et Lucia passent ensemble à la banque. À partir de là, déposez votre argent aux distributeurs dès que possible.
Autre conseil : ne dépensez pas vos premiers gains en peinture de voiture ou en accessoires. L'argent sert aussi à progresser dans l'histoire, puisqu'une mission de la fin du chapitre 2 exige 15 000 $ d'économies pour être lancée.
Souvent, et à la main. GTA 6 ne propose pas de rejeu de mission : une fois terminée, une mission ne peut pas être refaite. Si vous ratez quelque chose, il faudra recharger une ancienne partie. Ouvrez le menu pause, choisissez de sauvegarder la partie et sélectionnez un emplacement : le jeu en propose 15.
Prenez l'habitude de créer une sauvegarde à part avant chaque mission importante, et surtout avant chaque fin de chapitre. C'est aussi indispensable avant d'utiliser des codes de triche : ils désactivent les sauvegardes et les trophées pour toute la session en cours.

GTA 6 : l'exécutable Xbox Series X|S fuité, le jeu complet circule en ligne
articles.txt:
La fuite massive de GTA 6 semble avoir franchi un nouveau cap. Le groupe de hackers connu sous le nom de CyberLeek a annoncé avoir diffusé l’exécutable de la version Xbox Series X|S du jeu, complétant ainsi la distribution illégale de l’intégralité du titre de Rockstar Games. Cette publication intervient après la mise en ligne, la semaine dernière, d’une archive de 209 Go contenant la quasi-totalité des fichiers du jeu.
Sur leur site, les hackers ont sobrement déclaré : « L’ex est sorti, toujours gratuit. C’est un cadeau de Noël anticipé de CyberLeek ». Le message, intitulé « Noël est arrivé en avance », accompagne la mise à disposition d’un petit fichier de 57 Mo qui contient l’exécutable manquant. Jusqu’à présent, la build diffusée ne pouvait pas être lancée, car il manquait ce composant essentiel. Désormais, l’ensemble du jeu est techniquement exploitable sur les consoles Xbox Series X|S modifiées ou via des émulateurs.
Cette fuite s’inscrit dans une série d’actions menées par CyberLeek, qui avait déjà fait parler de lui en diffusant des informations et des fichiers du jeu très attendu. Le groupe affirme ne pas rechercher de gain financier direct, mais plutôt à « passer le relais aux projets open source de recompilation et d’émulation ». Ils ont toutefois tenté de monétiser leur action via une cryptomonnaie mème, sans succès notable.
L’objectif affiché par CyberLeek est de favoriser le travail des moddeurs et des développeurs amateurs qui souhaitent porter GTA 6 sur PC. En effet, le jeu n’est officiellement annoncé que sur consoles pour le moment, et aucune version PC n’a été confirmée par Rockstar Games. La fuite de l’exécutable Xbox pourrait donc permettre à des équipes de passionnés de créer une version jouable sur ordinateur, en s’appuyant sur des outils de recompilation et d’émulation.
Un projet communautaire, baptisé Leonida , a déjà vu le jour. Ses membres tentent d’utiliser certains fichiers issus du dump de CyberLeek pour reconstruire le jeu sur PC. Cependant, ils affirment vouloir adopter une approche « éthique » : ils n’intégreront pas les assets du jeu (textures, modèles, sons, etc.) dans leur travail. Les utilisateurs devront donc posséder une copie légitime du jeu pour en extraire ces éléments, ce qui vise à éviter la diffusion pure et simple de contenu piraté.
La diffusion de l’exécutable et des fichiers du jeu constitue une violation massive du droit d’auteur et des conditions d’utilisation de Rockstar Games. L’éditeur, connu pour sa politique stricte en matière de protection de ses propriétés intellectuelles, pourrait engager des poursuites contre les responsables de la fuite et les sites qui hébergent les fichiers. De plus, les joueurs qui téléchargeraient ces fichiers s’exposent à des risques de sécurité, car les archives peuvent contenir des logiciels malveillants.
Sur le plan technique, la recompilation d’un jeu aussi complexe que GTA 6 est un défi de taille. Les jeux modernes sont optimisés pour des architectures spécifiques, et porter le code sur PC nécessite des compétences avancées en rétro-ingénierie. Même si l’exécutable Xbox Series X|S est disponible, il faudra probablement des mois, voire des années, avant qu’une version PC jouable ne voie le jour, si elle voit le jour.
Cette fuite intervient alors que GTA 6 est l’un des jeux les plus attendus de l’histoire, avec une sortie prévue pour 2025 sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar Games n’a pas encore réagi officiellement à cette affaire, mais il est probable que l’éditeur renforce ses mesures de sécurité pour éviter de nouvelles fuites. Certains analystes estiment que cet incident pourrait retarder le développement ou la sortie du jeu, mais rien n’est confirmé.
En attendant, la communauté des joueurs est partagée entre l’excitation de voir des images du jeu et la condamnation de ces actes de piratage. Beaucoup rappellent que le piratage nuit à l’industrie et peut compromettre la qualité des futurs jeux. D’autres, impatients de découvrir le titre, sont tentés de télécharger les fichiers, malgré les risques.
Quoi qu’il en soit, cette affaire souligne une fois de plus les défis auxquels sont confrontés les grands éditeurs face aux hackers déterminés. La sécurité des jeux en développement est devenue un enjeu majeur, et les fuites peuvent avoir des conséquences importantes sur le plan commercial et créatif.

articles.t: Forget GTA 6, Taylor Sheridan’s New 8-Part Crime Series Officially Releases Next Month
articles.chapeau: It's just missing a jet-skiing dog
articles.txt:
The impact of Grand Theft Auto VI truly can't be overstated . The latest installment of Rockstar Games' franchise has been dominating the conversation as of late, as players discover all the debauchery that can be found in the fictional Vice City . If GTA 6 's high-stakes antics somehow leave you wanting more (or you're just waiting to get the right console to play the game on in the first place), the latest Taylor Sheridan epic to hit the small screen might be able to help.
Frisco King , the new crime television series created by Sheridan, is set to debut on Paramount+ on Friday, December 18th. While that day is already stacked from a pop culture standpoint, thanks to the "Dunesday" double feature of Dune: Part Three and Avengers: Doomsday , the premiere episodes of Frisco King will still offer an interesting set of stakes.
Led by Oscar-nominated actor and Marvel Cinematic Universe star Samuel L. Jackson, Frisco King is a spin-off of Tulsa King , Sheridan's hit series that stars Sylvester Stallone as a mob boss setting up a criminal enterprise in Oklahoma . Tulsa King has already run for four seasons since it first premiered in 2022, and was renewed for a fifth season this past October. Now, the series' general concept will be headed to the Dallas-Fort Worth suburb of Frisco — an area that is definitely a lot less intense than any of the locales featured in Grand Theft Auto , but will still be fun to see Jackson explore.
According to Paramount Television Studios' official description for the series, Frisco King follows seasoned New Orleans gangster Russell Lee Washington Jr. (played by Jackson) as he lands in Frisco, Texas, and discovers a hustler’s playground hidden beneath the polished surface of American suburbia. Recruiting an ambitious protégé, a loyal driver, and a growing network of eccentric partners, Lee transforms small hustles into big business. But, every new score raises the stakes, and as his influence grows, so do the risks, forcing Lee to stay one grift ahead. Frisco may not know it yet, but its new king has arrived.
The cast of Frisco King also includes Asa Germann ( Gen V, Scream 7 ) as Teddy, a sharp, savvy, entrepreneurial college dropout who becomes Lee’s protégé; Kai Caster ( Spider-Noir, Yellowstone ) as Keith, a Texas-bred polite valet at the local Sandman Hotel recruited by Lee; Lilah Pate ( The Runarounds, The Summer I Turned Pretty ) as London and Savanna Gann ( Rebel Moon - Part One: A Child of Fire, His & Hers ) as Avery, local cheerleaders recruited by Lee who are not afraid to use their charm to get what they want. Stallone will also reprise his Tulsa King role of Dwight "The General" Manfredi.
Jackson executive produces Frisco King alongside Stallone, Sheridan, David C. Glasser, Ron Burkle, David Hutkin, Bob Yari, Christina Alexandra Voros, Michael Friedman, LaTanya Richardson Jackson and Keith Cox. Voros and Friedman each directed four episodes of the series.

articles.t: GTA 6 sur PC : quelle configuration prévoir pour 60 FPS ?
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 sur PC : pas de version officielle, mais des estimations de configuration circulent. Carte graphique, processeur et SSD à prévoir pour viser 60 FPS.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 sur PC n’existe toujours pas officiellement, mais la question de la configuration à prévoir circule déjà, avec des estimations qui tentent de dire quelle machine permettrait d’y jouer dans de bonnes conditions. Précisons d’emblée qu’il ne s’agit en aucun cas de spécifications de Rockstar : le jeu est sorti le 19 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S, et sa page officielle ne mentionne pas le PC.
Rappelons que des projets amateurs tentent de le faire tourner sous Windows à partir d’une version Xbox ayant fuité, sans résultat jouable pour l’instant, et que des rumeurs évoquent une version PC plus tôt que prévu , sans confirmation. Chez Rockstar , ni calendrier ni configuration n’ont été communiqués. Bref, mieux vaut prendre ces chiffres comme un repère pour un futur achat et non comme un feu vert pour changer de carte graphique demain matin.
La console de référence tourne à 30 FPS : Rockstar a lancé le jeu avec le même objectif sur PS5, PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X et Xbox Series S , sans mode Performance. Sur PC, les estimations visent plutôt 60 FPS. La PS5 se rapprocherait d’une Radeon RX 6700 non XT, ce qui donne un point de départ pour juger la puissance nécessaire.
Côté système, Windows est le seul candidat logique. La compatibilité Linux reste incertaine, notamment pour le mode en ligne, et le jeu pourrait ne pas arriver sur Steam dès le départ, une hypothèse à prendre avec des pincettes. Autant dire que la réponse à la question « mon PC peut-il faire tourner GTA 6 ? » est pour l’instant un « non » sans appel, faute de version à installer.
Pour viser 60 FPS avec des réglages équivalents à ceux de la console, les estimations citent une GeForce RTX 3080, une RTX 4070 ou une Radeon RX 7800 XT. Côté mémoire vidéo, 8 Go seraient un minimum, et davantage serait préférable. Si vous achetez aujourd’hui, la GeForce RTX 5070 , plus récente que la RTX 4070 citée, se place dans la même zone de performances, sans que rien ne garantisse le résultat final.
Un Ryzen 3000 ou un Intel de 8e génération permettrait de lancer le jeu, mais probablement entre 30 et 40 FPS. Pour 60 FPS, une plateforme DDR5 ou un Intel Raptor Lake serait préférable, la plupart des processeurs AM5 devant suffire, alors que le Ryzen 7 5800X3D reste un point d’interrogation. Dans cette catégorie, le Ryzen 7 7800X3D fait partie des AM5 les plus prisés des joueurs, et nous y avons consacré un bon plan Black Friday . Notez que le processeur est aussi ce qui empêche un mode 60 FPS sur PS5 Pro.
Les estimations tablent sur environ 220 Go de SSD, avec un PCIe 3.0 x4 comme minimum et un PCIe 4.0 de préférence, le SATA étant déconseillé. Pour comparaison, la version PS5 pèserait 210 Go , un chiffre que Rockstar n’a pas confirmé. Un SSD NVMe de 2 To laisserait de la marge pour le jeu et quelques autres titres (la place disparaît vite, on le sait tous que trop bien).
Autre point, la génération d’images ne serait pas à conseiller, sauf si le jeu tourne déjà au-dessus de 50 FPS. Pour mesurer l’exigence, GTA V Enhanced aurait du mal à dépasser 40 FPS en conduite avec tout le ray tracing activé sur un Ryzen 7 PRO 4750G associé à une RTX 5070 Ti, alors que GTA VI est nettement plus détaillé. Aucune quantité de mémoire vive ni résolution cible n’est avancée à ce stade.
Rien ne presse tant que Rockstar n’a rien annoncé, mais les promotions du Black Friday peuvent justifier de préparer sa machine. Les stocks et les tarifs varient vite d’un marchand à l’autre, d’où l’intérêt de comparer avant de valider son panier.
Nous retenons trois composants qui couvrent l’essentiel d’une configuration pour jouer, chacun proposé chez plusieurs marchands français.

articles.t: GTA 6 Is Officially Making Boyfriends and Husbands Step Up Their Game
articles.chapeau: Jason's GTA 6 missions where he preps for Lucia's arrival are actively influencing boyfriends and husbands playing Rockstar's open-world game
articles.txt:
At its heart, Grand Theft Auto 6 is a game about a relationship between two people , Jason and Lucia, trying to lead a good life while navigating an unjust system. Controversially, early segments of the game give the players the option to do nice things for their partner, like buying Lucia jewelry and flowers . Those missions gained a surprising amount of mainstream attention due to the contrast between inattentive boyfriends treating their digital girlfriends "better" than their living, breathing partners.
It seems that the game's thoughtful message has gotten through to some of its players, judging from social media posts and reports from real-world florists .
In one Instagram post with over a million views, the account pappasparlor shows someone reaching into the flower display at a local grocery store. "Getting my wife some flowers since I already bought a bouquet for Lucia," reads the text overlaid on the footage.
In another viral Instagram post with 2.8 million views , a woman named Montana recorded herself holding a bouquet of roses while her partner sat on the couch holding a PlayStation 5 controller. "POV: he bought Lucia flowers in GTA 6 so he bought me flowers too," the post reads.
Yet another popular Instagram post shows a young man walking into the frame holding up a display of pink flowers in a vase . "Got a haircut and brought her flowers since I got a haircut and bought flowers for Lucia in GTA 6. "
Of course , some of these posts might be performative or exist​​​​​​​ for clout — especially if the account is one focused on relationships to begin with. The phenomenon is widespread enough to be noticeable, which means that average GTA 6 fans are being influenced as well.
Over the weekend, one popular post on Threads by @muvashutta described a scene at a grocery store that was so jarring​​​​​​​ , they got worried they had forgotten​​​​​​​ about an important flower-related occasion, like Mother's Day. "There is an unprecedented number of men buying flowers in this Publix tonight," the post stated.
The post itself does not attribute the sighting to GTA 6 , but the comments — which include a real florist — do.
"CAN CONFIRM," reads a reply from a florist on muvashutta's post. "The boys are buying flowers for their Lucias."
Another commenter claimed that they saw "three youngish men picking out flowers at Publix tonight and the produce guy walked by them and said Ooooooo Lucia will appreciate this!"
Sensing an opportunity, some flower shops are goading men to take action as well. In a recent advertisement by Atelier Flowers , the company used an AI-generated image of a GTA protagonist walking into a florist. "GTA 6 can wait ... but your girlfriend's flowers can't. Gentlemen, consider this your next mission: keep your girl happy. Skip the wanted level and earn some boyfriend points instead."
Grand Theft Auto 6 Image: Rockstar Games ​​​​​​​While there are many posts from flower shops on social media, an unexpected number of these posts​​​​​​​ aren't directed at boyfriends or husbands. Florists are instead targeting women by suggesting that if their boyfriend can buy GTA 6 or treat Lucia well, then they can afford a real bouquet for their loved ones as well. One video showing a flower arrangement states, "If he remembered to pre-order AND pre-download GTA 6 he can remember to pre-order your flowers."
While some men are learning how to be more thoughtful partners, others are experiencing a role reversal. Steven Trombetta on X.com recently shared a photograph of a colorful floral arrangement​​​​​​​ tied to a heart-shaped balloon. The bouquet was themed around GTA 6 's primary colors. "My wife bought me flowers to celebrate the game's launch ... I'm the luckiest man in the world."

articles.chapeau: With a release date for the GTA 6 PC port unknown, a leaked Xbox build could ease the wait. Cyberleek has now distributed an executable file that may provide a playable solution. Various groups have attempted to adapt the console version to boot on Windows desktops and laptops.
articles.txt:
The notorious Cyberleek circulated a 209 GB GTA 6 Xbox build on November 19th, but it was missing an essential file. They have now released the executable ahead of schedule, along with an update on a secret project. The development is welcome news to groups working to adapt the build to a playable PC port .
To unlock an earlier release , the individual had asked supporters to reach a $15 million market cap for his meme coin. The cryptocurrency goal was later lowered to $6 million. Regardless, once the November 23rd deadline passed, they promised to distribute the .exe. Just before the countdown clock expired, the it began appearing on piracy sites .
Cyberleek predicted that the GTA 6 Xbox build would lead to a bootable PC version within a week. Possibilities included an emulator , although no app currently simulates the console. GitHub projects like Leonida have also endeavored to modify the files to run natively on Windows. The Series X uses the familiar x86-64 CPU architecture, but many roadblocks remain.
Unfortunately, for Steam users who also support piracy, the executable doesn’t make the game playable right away. Hackers still have to tackle issues like translating shaders and memory management. Regardless, developers can study the file, in hopes of creating Windows compatibility layers.
With the .exe for the Xbox build, Cyberleek attached a text file, reiterating their intentions. They explain that past gameplay leaks included no story spoilers to avoid hurting players. Instead, the target is Take-Two Interactive and Rockstar , who delayed a release date for a GTA 6 PC port.
The cryptocurrency funds are supposedly raising money for a project that is “for the gamers”. While details are scarce, it’s teased as more significant than any Grand Theft Auto leak.
Despite achieving a record-tying average Metacritic score of 99 , the Rockstar project has suffered review bombing . The user rating stands at around 5.7/10 after over 100,000 evaluations. While most of the 0 scores may be unwarranted, performance limits are a common criticism. Cyberleek identified the 30 fps cap as a potential major advantage to a GTA 6 PC option.

articles.t: GTA VI sur PC : l'exécutable a fuité, Leonida franchit les premières étapes du démarrage
articles.chapeau: CyberLeek a publié l'exécutable de la build Xbox de GTA VI. Leonida l'a chargé en une heure, mais le jeu n'affiche encore aucune image sur PC.
articles.txt:
C'était la pièce manquante. Depuis le 19 novembre, une archive de 209 Go présentée comme la build Xbox 1.0.2.1 de GTA VI circulait par torrent, mise en ligne par CyberLeek sans son exécutable principal, le fichier qui contient tout le code du jeu. Le leaker avait promis de le publier « sans condition » le 23 novembre, et il a tenu parole. Le fichier est accompagné d'empreintes SHA-256 permettant de vérifier les téléchargements, ce qui ne garantit pas pour autant qu'il provienne de Rockstar Games . Ni l'éditeur ni sa maison mère Take-Two n'avaient encore réagi en fin de journée.
L'exécutable ne serait pas chiffré, et c'est ce qui change tout pour Leonida , le projet de recompilation statique dont nous détaillions le fonctionnement et l'avancée il y a deux jours. Son auteur, ItsNotRexed , déjà à l'origine de Hookshot, le portage PC du remake de Zelda Ocarina of Time , assurait que tout ce qui pouvait être fait sans ce fichier était prêt. Selon Numerama , les développeurs l'ont chargé dans leur outil moins d'une heure après sa publication.
Sur la machine d'un contributeur, avec des correctifs pas encore intégrés au projet, le jeu passe déjà une douzaine d'étapes de son démarrage : il réserve sa mémoire, crée son périphérique graphique et plus de 500 listes de commandes, soit environ 1 200 appels graphiques. Il se bloque ensuite sur la gestion de la mémoire graphique, l'un des points où la Xbox et le PC diffèrent le plus. Autrement dit, le code du jeu tourne bel et bien sur PC, mais il n'affiche encore rien.
Pour John Papadopoulos , de DSOGaming , le message est clair : l'exécutable ne permet pas, à lui seul, de jouer à GTA VI sur PC, et il n'y a aucune raison de le télécharger. Il ne sert qu'aux développeurs qui travaillent déjà sur un portage ou un futur émulateur Xbox Series, et ce travail prendra du temps. Les vidéos qui prétendent montrer le jeu tourner sur PC sont fausses, et de faux portages truffés de logiciels malveillants circulent depuis des mois.
Reste la question juridique. Utiliser une build diffusée par un leaker est illégal, et Take-Two , qui avait déjà multiplié les demandes de retrait et assigné Discord et Microsoft pour identifier CyberLeek cet été, devrait réagir. L'éditeur pourrait chercher à faire fermer Leonida , ou être tenté d'avancer une version PC officielle, que la rumeur annonce pour 2027.

articles.t: GTA 6 Leaker Cyberleek Reportedly Releases .exe File for Xbox Build, Sparking Concern an Unofficial PC Port Could Be Around the Corner
articles.chapeau: Cyberleek has reportedly made good on their promise and released the executable file for the leaked Xbox build of GTA 6, sparking concern that an unofficial PC port could be around the corner.
articles.txt:
Cyberleek has reportedly made good on their promise and released the executable file for the leaked Xbox build of GTA 6 , sparking concern that an unofficial PC port could be around the corner.
The infamous hacker had vowed to release the .exe for the incomplete GTA 6 Xbox build whether the Cyberleek memecoin hit its market cap target or not , and now it is out in the wild, some within the homebrew scene are preparing to take a close look at it.
Cyberleek released the exe with a fresh statement insisting their actions on GTA 6 so far were about “fighting anti-consumerism in the games industry.” Cyberleek also taunts Rockstar parent company Take-Two’s so-far unsuccessful effort to prevent further leaks or, it seems, track down those responsible, saying: “Months of takedowns, subpoenas and wallet tracing later, the hunt is still on and the uploads keep arriving.”
They also pushed back on claims the GTA 6 leaks are about little more than pushing a crypto scheme, insisting that crypto was used to generate funds for a secret project outside of the game. “There is no other way to move funds without names,” Cyberleek said, “and this work requires no names.”
Some are now predicting that AI-assisted recompilation of the leaked Xbox build could result in GTA 6 on PC in just days, with performance improvements over the console version in weeks.
This is of course a nightmare scenario for Take-Two and Sony and Microsoft, which are benefiting greatly from GTA 6 releasing on console only. The console version of GTA 6 targets 30fps across all platforms, although struggles at times to hit that on base PS5, and Xbox Series X and S. As a result, there is huge interest in a potential PC version offering 60fps gameplay.
The release of the Xbox build from this month runs counter to the thought that Cyberleek only had access to an early development build of GTA 6, a feeling that was reinforced not only by the videos that were released in the summer, but by the differences that have emerged following the game’s official launch.
Fans are calling on people not to spend money on Cyberleek, pointing out the leaker cashed out back in August and did again in October. Analysis of cryptocurrency transactions in late August pointed to the GTA 6 leaker cashing out having earnt around $270,000.
IGN had reported on fan skepticism around the alleged leaked gameplay that reportedly showed both Jason and Lucia fully naked . A previous leaked gameplay video allegedly showed a tank spawning into the world, which suggested access to a dev menu of some kind. The leaked videos allegedly showing both Jason and Lucia fully naked also show NPCs failing to react to that in any way, which suggested this effect was achieved with either a dev menu or cheats.
In the wake of Cyberleek’s initial leaks, Take-Two issued subpoenas to the likes of Discord as part of its search for the person or group of people responsible. It remains unclear how the gameplay footage, any potential build of the game it was taken from, or this latest Xbox build, escaped the confines of Rockstar's infamous tight security.
In August, Rockstar addressed the GTA 6 leaks , describing the situation as "heartbreaking" for its development team and "unfortunate" for fans. At the time, the developer acknowledged that its intended experience for players "may now be impacted by some spoilers," but reiterated GTA 6's previously-confirmed launch date of November 19.

articles.chapeau: Arion Kurtaj pleaded guilty last week to hacking major companies between 2021 and 2022, including GTA-maker Rockstar Games and ride-hailing giant Uber
articles.txt:
A UK court sentenced a British hacker to seven years in jail Monday for a series of cyberattacks, including leaking footage from Grand Theft Auto (GTA) 6 , years before the blockbuster game's release.
Having already served years in custody, Arion Kurtaj, aged 21, was entitled to walk free immediately, Judge Mark Turner said at London's Woolwich Crown Court.
Kurtaj, who is autistic, pleaded guilty last week to hacking major companies between 2021 and 2022, including GTA-maker Rockstar Games, mobile operator BT/EE, digital bank Revolut and ride-hailing giant Uber.
Stay up to date with the latest news. Follow KT on WhatsApp Channels.
Turner described the offences as "sophisticated attacks upon big companies".
The judge said his sentencing decision required "balancing the seriousness of what you did with, on the other hand, your young age" and medical diagnoses.
Kurtaj was a teenager when he carried out the attacks as a key member of the so-called Lapsus$ hacking group.
He was initially charged over hacking BT/EE and placed in a hotel for his own protection from rival hackers in September 2022, according to the Crown Prosecution Service.
But from his hotel room, he went on to carry out cyberattacks on Revolut, Uber and Rockstar.
Using just a mobile phone, the hotel's wifi-connected TV and an Amazon Fire TV Stick, he broke into Rockstar systems and obtained 90 videos of the highly-anticipated GTA VI game.
He leaked the videos online under the username "TeaPotUberHacker," more than a year before the first official footage was released by Rockstar, causing a frenzy across the video game industry.
The hack disrupted the release strategy for the sixth installment of the GTA franchise, which was finally released last week after a 13-year wait.
In 2023, a jury concluded that Kurtaj, whom psychiatrists at the time had deemed unfit to stand trial, was responsible for numerous computer misuse, fraud and blackmail offences.
Due to the severity of his autism, he was placed under a hospital order where he remained for two years before being found fit to stand trial, his lawyers said.

articles.t: GTA 6’s Best-Kept Secret Is the Key to Its Whole Design
articles.chapeau: It all begins and ends with one very specific character.
articles.txt: Warning: this story contains spoilers for GTA 6’s prologue and Chapter 1. In the final months of trailers, screenshots, and extended looks leading up to Grand Theft Auto 6 ’s launch, Rockstar was keeping a huge secret. It had revealed Jason and Lucia to the world years before and, by the summer of this year, we knew that their romantic relationship was core to the story. But until the moment the game went live, we had no idea that the pair were parents. As we all found out in the prologue, Jason and Lucia have a son, Tomás. And more than just a baby, this little infant is the key to GTA 6’s entire design ethos. Historically, Rockstar has drawn from classic crime movie tropes to establish the themes of its stories. Tommy Vercetti cut through all in his path on his way to becoming Miami’s premier crime lord. Carl Johnson rallied the boys in the hood on his quest for revenge. And Niko Bellic put his war-honed killing skills to work on the streets of Liberty City. While there are elements of relatability in all these stories – hurt over dead mothers, discovering the lie of the American dream – you’d be in the tiny minority of players if you could claim to truly recognise the lives of GTA’s protagonists as reflections of your own timeline.

Unofficial PC port efforts like Leonida, an AI-assisted, static recompilation, are translating shaders to run the Xbox build on PC. Rockstar hasn't announced an official GTA 6 PC release; fan ports or emulation could produce a playable PC build soon. Cyberleek, the same individual or group behind the GTA 6 leaks from earlier this year, said they planned to release the missing Xbox executable for Grand Theft Auto 6 ( GTA 6 ) , and they've followed through. The file is now publicly available, completing the 209GB Xbox build Cyberleek leaked last week on private torrent trackers.
On their website, Cyberleek wrote that "the exe is out. Always free." Cyberleek also published SHA-256 hashes for GTA 6's executable and its ZIP archive, emphasizing that users should verify the files before downloading them. Cyberleek's website appears to be down right now. Several GTA 6 PC porting projects are underway, but the most notable is Leonida, from the same developer behind one of the best early PC static recompilations of the Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time .
Leonida aims to bring the Xbox version of GTA 6 to Windows through a static recompilation that includes shader translation and an Xbox compatibility runtime. Because Xbox Series X/S consoles and Windows PCs share the x86-64 CPU architecture, the project can potentially run a lot of the game's CPU code natively.
NotRexed , the Leonida's developer, says that all 26,503 RDNA2 shaders have already been translated to Vulkan SPIR-V. The other compatibility tools that are needed to run the Xbox version of GTA 6 on PC are also in the works, according to NotRexed. Of course, like nearly every similar project that's launched recently, Lenoida is AI-assisted.
Credit: Rockstar While the Xbox build of GTA 6 leaked last week, it was missing its executable, which kept developers eager to port the game to PC from truly starting their projects. So what does this all mean?
Well, a playable PC version of GTA 6 could launch in the next few days if projects like Leonida can pull off the porting process. Alongside Leonida, there are broader Xbox Series X/S translation and emulation efforts like Xbox2Windows , ScarlettX , and AnyXboxX .
In other GTA 6 -related news, with PS5 Remote Play or a capture card, plus apps like Veyra and a powerful gaming PC, several people have been able to run GTA 6 at 60fps and above with DLSS 5 . While GTA 6 is now available on the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, Rockstar hasn't announced a PC version. Rumors point to an official PC release arriving somewhere between six months and a year from now, similar to GTA V .

articles.txt:
The hacker behind the massive GTA 6 leak in September 2022 has been released on license with a strong warning from the judge. Having already served the majority of his seven year sentence, Arion Kurtaj, from Oxford in the United Kingdom, was allowed to go free, conditionally.
According to the BBC , the judge warned Kurtaj: "Don't let this happen again."
Kurtaj attempted to extort GTA 6 developer Rockstar Games in 2022. After socially engineering his way into the company Slack, the now 21-year-old threatened to release clips of the unfinished game unless Rockstar paid a ransom. He pleaded guilty to the hacking offenses , which he carried out when he was 16 and 17 years old, earlier this week.

Originally, Kurtaj was sentenced to an indefinite stay in a prison hospital due to his autism diagnosis. After reconsideration, he was deemed fit to stand trial and spent the remainder of his time in a traditional prison, starting in January.
With his release, Kurtaj has been given a Serious Crime Prevention Order, which restricts his interactions online, barring him from using social apps like Telegram and Discord, in an attempt to prevent him working with hacker groups. The order will last for five years.
The hack happened while Kurtaj was already under police protection in a Travelodge with his computer confiscated. During his stay, he used an Amazon Fire Stick and the hotel television to hack Rockstar, Revolut, and Uber.
The GTA 6 hack saw him steal 90 clips of an unfinished build well before Rockstar was ready to show gameplay from its anticipated open-world sequel, which launched last week. It resulted in the first major GTA 6 leak, as early gameplay footage was shared online. Here, we saw dual protagonists Jason and Lucia for the first time. These clips were shared under the online name TeaPotUberHacker. It would be over a year before Rockstar finally showed the protagonists itself, and even longer until we got an official gameplay reveal, which was only shared in August of this year.

articles.t: GTA 6 Unofficial PC Requirements: Ryzen 5 5600X, 8GB RTX 30
articles.chapeau: Unofficial GTA 6 PC requirements list a Ryzen 5 5600X and an 8GB RTX 30 card, but the Leonida project does not boot and Rockstar has set none.
articles.txt:
Photo: Fritzchens Fritz from Berlin, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons An unofficial PC project for Grand Theft Auto VI now has a preliminary hardware list, and it asks for less than many players feared. According to reports that include GameGPU, the list calls for an AMD Ryzen 5 5600X or a similar Intel processor, plus an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 30-series card with at least 8 GB of video memory or an AMD equivalent.
The list belongs to Leonida, a fan effort that aims to recompile the Xbox version of the game for Windows. Its creator goes by REXD. Coverage says the project does not boot, and nobody has shown it playable. Rockstar has published no PC requirements of its own. Our earlier look at the 209 GB Xbox dump and the missing emulator explains why the raw material alone does not put the game on a PC.
This analysis separates what the reports confirm from what they do not. It walks through each line of the spec, explains what the numbers imply for the hardware you own, and looks at the market angle. It also sets out five predictions for the weeks ahead. One point comes first: this is a fan project’s wish list for a build that does not run yet, and it says nothing official about Grand Theft Auto VI on PC. Browse our hardware coverage for the wider context on GPUs, CPUs and memory.

Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
The circulated list is short. It names a processor, a graphics card, system memory and free disk space. Every entry comes from the reports on the project, and none of them comes from Rockstar or from a published benchmark run.
Read the table as a floor, not a target. The 8 GB entry is the minimum, and the same reports say those cards are meant for low settings. Nothing in the coverage says what a higher tier would look like, so any claim about a recommended or ultra tier would be invention.
The list also carries an important qualifier. Full support may not be available at launch, according to the reports. They leave open whether launch means the first public build of Leonida or something else, so treat that line as a warning about rough edges rather than a date.
Related guides: Away from the news cycle, Run LLMs locally on an RTX 5090 is one of the guides on this subject area that we keep current; the Shattered guides page lists it with our other setup guides and comparisons, grouped by what you are trying to do, each with a short description so you can tell what you will get before you click.
Leonida is described as an unofficial effort to recompile the Xbox version of Grand Theft Auto VI so it can run on Windows. The reports identify its creator as REXD. They give no team size, no funding source and no public code repository, so we do not state any of those.
A studio port starts from source code and rebuilds the game for a new platform. A fan recompile starts from the finished console binaries. Projects of this type generally translate the console program into code a PC can run natively, then replace the console’s graphics and system calls with PC equivalents. That second step is where most of the work lives, and it is also where a spec list can drift far from reality.
The distinction matters for the hardware numbers. A studio port is tuned by the people who wrote the renderer, and they can set requirements from measured frame times. A recompile has no such baseline. Its authors can estimate, but they cannot know how the translated game behaves until it boots and runs for long enough to profile.
The reports name REXD, and nothing in the fact sheet says more about that person. Readers should weigh the project by what it shows, not by a handle. At the time of coverage, what it showed was a build that does not boot.
The coverage states plainly that the project was not booting and not yet playable. No verified gameplay result exists. That single fact outweighs every line in the spec table, because a requirement list for software that cannot start is a plan, not a measurement.
